name: Mission Hospital High School Auxiliary (Providence)
city: Mission Viejo and Laguna Beach, CA
what_you_do: Volunteer for 4 hours a week in a hospital department. You help patients, visitors and staff but do not give direct patient care. You stay in the program until you graduate.
who_can_apply: You must attend a local high school. You must be a freshman, sophomore or junior when you apply. You must turn 15 by February 1 of the following year.
pay_detail: Unpaid. You pay a one-time $125 membership fee for an ID badge, polo shirt and jacket. You also buy black khakis and shoes.
duration: One 4-hour shift a week, year round, until you graduate
deadline_text: Applications open September 1 and are due by the 3rd Monday of October. Applications received before or after that date are not accepted. The form is for the 2027 group.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form for the 2027 group. The link is on the program page. Add two recommendation letters: one from a teacher and one from a coach, mentor or supervisor. Add a resume with no photo. Add a personal statement of at least 300 words. Answer the short essay questions. Some students then get an interview.
notes: Chosen students need a TB test and proof of vaccines. They also go to registration, orientation, training and shadowing shifts. The earliest start is usually March. Shifts are Monday to Friday 4 to 8 p.m., or on weekends. There are no summer-only spots. Email MHAuxiliary@providence.org or call 949-364-1400 ext. 7944.
